definition: Percentage of rentable units in an active occupied rental state at the end of the facility's local operating day.
population_definition: Rentable units assigned to the facility and effective for the observation date.
inclusion_rules: Include units whose rental state is active_occupied at event-time cutoff
Include only units effective within the named facility on the observation date
exclusion_rules: Exclude units whose identity is unresolved or cross-facility conflicted
change_summary: Removes offline-maintenance and company-use spaces from the denominator and changes the governing cutoff from recorded UTC midnight to facility-local end of operating day.
evidence_boundary: Fictional teaching contract only; schema conformance does not establish a real metric, approved definition, source authority, historical comparability, operational fitness, or measured result.
